basis: Forebrain nonseparation; ocular developmental abnormalities reported in 80-99%, median upper-lip cleft in 30-79%. Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic; aspiration is secondary.
Ichthyotic keratoderma and hypomyelinating spastic disorder; sensorineural hearing loss in 2/2, optic pallor and visual-field loss in 1/2. Small reported cohort limits frequency certainty.
Inherited distal motor neuron/axon disease; muscle weakness and wasting reflect denervation rather than primary skeletal-muscle disease.
The supplied definition specifies congenital structural heart disease. No evidence establishes common direct damage to additional organs.
CLCN1-related skeletal-muscle channelopathy causing myotonia, stiffness and weakness; neuromuscular ancestry does not establish nerve or neuromuscular-junction disease.
Amyloid disease of cerebral vessels with defining brain injury from recurrent hemorrhage; stroke and cerebellar hemorrhage reported in 4/4.
Soft-tissue smooth-muscle sarcoma, provisionally mapped to musculoskeletal; anatomical origin is unspecified. A uterine child and EBV-associated ancestor do not establish site or infection.
Persistent fetal ocular vasculature produces vitreoretinal malformation, cataract and visual impairment. The vascular remnants are localized components of the eye disorder.
Nonsyndromic X-linked intellectual developmental disorder; no additional organ involvement is established.
Epidermal nevi, subcutaneous lipomatosis and vascular malformations define the syndrome; reduced bone density occurs in 30-79%. Thyroid and other cancers are minority risks.
